scoring_guide.title: How Investment Guide scoring works
scoring_guide.intro: Point-sum shortlist for SP/SSP chip investment on mobile suits and pilots (Attack / Defense / Support). Units have separate SP and SSP boards; pilots use SP only. Criteria favor practical sortie tools (MAP, mobility follow-ups, weapon power) over pure roster breadth. Close letters still need a human look.
overrides: Each axis adds points; the total becomes a letter, then a bucket (Recommended / Solid / Situational / Niche).
Filter by tag or Eternal Road Expert stage to compare units that actually fit the same restriction.
gaps: Letter cutoffs use separate scales for SP-eligible units/pilots vs UR/Ultimate, so UR kits do not lock out Recommended for chip investment targets.
Pilot recommended-MS points use this list's unit letters (SP/SSP best).
Strategic tag weights use how often tags appear on UR rosters (calibrated table).
Close letters still need a human look.

criteria.title: Buckets from letters
criteria.summary: Point total maps to a letter, then to a bucket. Players mainly see buckets.

criteria.title: Eternal Road Expert access
criteria.summary: How many ER Expert stages the unit or pilot can sortie into (tag/series eligibility, including unit+character type-3 rules).

criteria.title: Strategic tags
criteria.summary: Non-flavor tags scored by how often they appear on UR units (limited UR counts more than permanent UR). Cap +2.

criteria.title: Terrain coverage (units)
criteria.summary: Deploy tier ≥2 counts as usable. SSP board uses SSP-upgraded terrain.

criteria.title: MOV (units)
criteria.summary: Primary movement axis by role. Follow-up (stacks, cap +2): after-move MAP and/or Chance Step / PostAttackMove.

criteria.title: Weapon power — SP board (Attack shown; Defense capped lower)
criteria.summary: Max non-MAP Lv5 power for the board. SP mediocrity ~5000–5400.

criteria.title: Weapon power — SSP board (Attack shown; Defense capped lower)
criteria.summary: Includes SSP enhance. SSP mediocrity ~6000.

criteria.title: Weapon conditional bonus (units)
criteria.summary: Best matching conditional weapon power / crit / DEF-debuff boost on the kit (from weapon effect data). Higher-range bonus ignored when max range ≤3.

criteria.title: Weapon range (units)
criteria.summary: Highest non-MAP weapon range on the board.

criteria.title: Combat flags (units)
criteria.summary: Small combat bonuses read from unit abilities and mechanisms.

criteria.title: Shield mechanism (units)
criteria.summary: Whether the unit has a shield (from unit mechanisms).

criteria.title: Unit SP-grown stats (HP / ATK / DEF / MOB)
criteria.summary: Role-specific bands; Attack table shown as the sample. Defense/Support use their own sheets.

criteria.title: Debuffs (Defense / Support units)
criteria.summary: Pierce % maps to levels (≈10%→3 … 40%+→6). Support also scores distinct debuff kinds at range ≥4.

criteria.title: Linked / recommend pilot (units)
criteria.summary: From recommend-character link: rarity index + same role as the unit.

rows.when: Linked, rarity index ≥4 and same role

criteria.title: MAP weapons (units)
criteria.summary: Practical MAP tools: presence for any MAP, extra for dash/MovingAttack, ammo 2+, and effect-range coverage. Combined cap +4.

criteria.title: Abilities / kit
criteria.summary: Scored from ability and skill effect data in the game masters. Permanent ATK/DEF/HP/MOV with no condition scores 0 here. Strong % effects use size bands (for example damage dealt 10/20/30%+). Unit ability axis caps at +3; pilot kit caps at +14.
